model.planner: planar double integrator with quadratic relative-air-velocity drag
model.execution: nonlinear rigid-body quadrotor, motors, flatness and geometric feedback
model.belief: POAM posterior, fixed kernel/inducing locations; real-observation sufficient-statistic updates only
model.filter: spline design-policy value and penalized squared slack; no safety guarantee
model.policy: geometric route classes plus MBD target/passage logits, speed, dwell and crossing offsets
model.collision_penalty: full remaining mission with no additional sensing
model.sensing: Gaussian quality inside 45-degree ground footprint, building visibility masks
